caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, oval-shaped mirror with an elaborately carved wooden frame. The frame is reddish-brown in color and features symmetrical decorative elements, including scrolls, floral patterns, and acanthus leaves. At the top center of the frame, there is a large, stylized floral motif, while both sides of the frame extend outward with leaf-like decorations. The lower part of the frame is anchored by two base supports, each adorned with intricate carvings and a winged, bird-like figure facing outward. The reflective surface of the mirror is light gray and dominates the center of the composition. The drawing is set against a plain, light background, and there is a handwritten signature in the lower right corner.
title: Table Mirror
